UPDATE routines
            SET slug = $3, name = $4, prompt = $5, agent_id = $6, project_id = $7,
                priority = $8, title_template = $9, timezone = $10, enabled = $11,
                if_open = $12, if_missed = $13, allow_writes = $14, archived = $15,
                updated_at = $16
            WHERE organization_id = $1 AND id = $2
